stop_conditions: Stop before a request that would exceed either ceiling.
Stop if the issuer timing changes or the event can no longer be proved pre-release.
Do not replace an unavailable source with an unrecorded provider or paid endpoint.

consensus.missingness_path: If Finnhub and Alpha Vantage provide no current estimate, preserve typed missingness and do not synthesize a value.
consensus.plan: Use the Finnhub near-term estimate and retain a separate Alpha Vantage cross-check when available.

history.blocking_rule: The acceptance run must produce three readable cutoff-safe cards; insufficient_history does not satisfy this run.

rights.checked_in_content: redistributable metadata and source links only
rights.public_summary_rule: Paraphrase supported facts; do not publish provider response bodies or transcript bodies.

information_barrier.eligibility_rule: Evidence must be available strictly before cutoff_at and must not contain the target outcome.
information_barrier.rationale: The cutoff is the prior regular-session close because the issuer says only before market open; 4:00 a.m. ET is a conservative earliest premarket boundary, not a claimed release time.
